name: Open Graph for WooCommerce
author: wbcomdesigns

sections.description:
Open Graph for WooCommerce helps your WooCommerce products look perfect when shared on social media. This comprehensive plugin automatically generates optimized Open Graph meta tags, Twitter Cards, and Schema.org structured data to boost your social media presence and SEO.

Perfect For

  • E-commerce stores wanting to increase social media engagement
  • Product-focused businesses needing better social sharing optimization
  • SEO professionals looking for comprehensive structured data support
  • Store owners who want professional social media integration

Key Features

Complete Social Media Support
* Facebook Open Graph optimization
* Twitter Cards with product data
* LinkedIn professional sharing
* Pinterest Rich Pins
* WhatsApp mobile sharing
* Email sharing functionality

Advanced Schema.org Markup
* Product schema with offers and reviews
* Organization and brand information
* Breadcrumb navigation markup
* Rich snippets for search engines

Beautiful Social Share Buttons
* 3 stunning styles: Modern, Classic, Minimal
* 7 social platforms supported
* Flexible positioning options
* Copy-to-clipboard functionality

Smart Image Handling
* Multiple image size options
* Automatic featured image detection
* Smart fallback images
* Optimized for social platforms

What Makes It Special

Unlike basic Open Graph plugins, Open Graph for WooCommerce is specifically designed for WooCommerce:

  • Product-focused: Includes pricing, availability, and product-specific data
  • Performance optimized: Only loads resources when needed
  • WordPress native: Clean interface following WordPress design standards
  • SEO friendly: Comprehensive Schema.org markup for better search visibility
  • Mobile optimized: Perfect sharing experience on all devices

Easy Setup

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Go to WooCommerce → Social Media in your admin
  3. Enable the platforms you want to support
  4. Configure your preferences
  5. Your products are now optimized for social sharing!

Supported Platforms

  • Facebook – Complete Open Graph implementation with App ID support
  • Twitter – Optimized Twitter Cards with product information
  • LinkedIn – Professional network sharing optimization
  • Pinterest – Rich Pins with product details
  • WhatsApp – Mobile-optimized sharing for instant messaging
  • Email – Traditional email sharing with formatted content
  • Copy Link – Modern clipboard integration

Technical Features

Meta Tags Generated:
* Open Graph: title, description, type, url, image, site_name
* Product data: price, currency, availability, brand, category
* Twitter Cards: summary_large_image with product pricing
* Facebook App ID integration for analytics

Schema.org Structured Data:
* Product schema with offers, reviews, ratings
* Organization schema with contact information
* BreadcrumbList for navigation
* Rich snippets for search engines

Performance Features:
* Conditional loading (only on relevant pages)
* Optimized database queries
* Smart caching system
* Minimal impact on page load times

Customization Options

Share Button Styles:
* Modern – Clean, hover-animated buttons with platform colors
* Classic – Bold, traditional rectangular buttons
* Minimal – Subtle circular icons for clean designs

Flexible Positioning:
* After Add to Cart Button (default)
* Before Add to Cart Button
* After Product Summary
* After Product Tabs
* Custom positioning via shortcode

Image Settings:
* Choose from multiple image sizes
* Set custom fallback images
* Automatic optimization for social platforms

Developer Friendly

Hooks & Filters:
* 20+ action and filter hooks
* Extensive customization options
* Template override support
* JavaScript API for custom events

Translation Ready:
* Full internationalization support
* RTL language compatibility
* POT files included for easy translation

What’s New in Version 2.0

This is a complete rewrite with massive improvements:

Modern Architecture:
* Object-oriented design following WordPress standards
* Enhanced security with proper sanitization
* Better performance with conditional loading
* Improved accessibility features

Enhanced Features:
* Added WhatsApp and Email sharing
* Introduced 3 beautiful share button styles
* Advanced Schema.org markup options
* Professional admin interface redesign

Better Performance:
* 70% reduction in asset size
* Optimized database queries
* Smart resource loading
* Improved caching system

Analytics Integration

  • Google Analytics 4 event tracking
  • Custom event triggers for third-party analytics
  • Social sharing performance metrics
  • Built-in debugging tools for troubleshooting

Technical Requirements

WordPress: 5.0 or higher
WooCommerce: 4.0 or higher
PHP: 7.4 or higher (8.0+ recommended for best performance)
MySQL: 5.6 or higher
Memory: 128MB minimum (256MB recommended)

Browser Support:
* Chrome 70+
* Firefox 65+
* Safari 12+
* Edge 79+
* Mobile: iOS Safari 12+, Chrome Mobile 70+

Performance Metrics:
* Page Load Impact: < 0.1s additional load time
* Database Queries: Optimized to minimize additional queries
* Memory Usage: < 2MB additional memory usage
* Asset Sizes: CSS ~15KB, JavaScript ~8KB (minified)

Privacy & GDPR

This plugin is fully GDPR compliant:

  • Does not collect or store personal user data
  • Does not use cookies or tracking scripts
  • Does not send data to external servers
  • Only processes publicly available product information
  • All social sharing is initiated by user action

Support & Documentation

Free Support:
* WordPress.org Support Forum
* Plugin Documentation

Premium Support:
* Priority Support
* Custom Development

Resources:
* Feature Requests
* GitHub Repository
* Video Tutorials

Credits

  • Original Concept: Based on community feedback and WooCommerce best practices
  • Icons: Social media icons from Simple Icons
  • Testing: Extensive testing by the WooCommerce community
  • Translations: Community contributors worldwide

Special thanks to all the beta testers and community members who helped make this plugin better!
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to your WordPress admin dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins → Add New
  3. Search for “Open Graph for WooCommerce”
  4. Click Install Now and then Activate
  5. Go to WooCommerce → Social Media to configure settings

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Upload via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  3. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu
  4. Configure settings under WooCommerce → Social Media

Quick Configuration

  1. Enable Platforms: Select which social media platforms to support
  2. Choose Style: Pick your preferred share button style
  3. Set Position: Choose where share buttons appear on product pages
  4. Configure Images: Set image sizes and fallback options
  5. Advanced Options: Enable Schema markup and other features
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, this plugin is specifically designed for WooCommerce stores and requires WooCommerce to be installed and active.

Will this plugin slow down my website?

No! The plugin is performance-optimized and only loads resources on product pages. The additional load time is typically less than 0.1 seconds.

Can I customize the share button appearance?

Absolutely! The plugin includes three built-in styles (Modern, Classic, Minimal) and provides extensive CSS classes for custom styling.

Does it work with other SEO plugins?

Yes, the plugin works harmoniously with other SEO plugins like Yoast, RankMath, and SEOPress. You can choose to override their meta tags if needed.

Is the plugin translation ready?

Yes, the plugin is fully internationalized with POT files included. It also supports RTL languages and follows WordPress translation standards.

Can I add custom social media platforms?

Yes, developers can add custom platforms using the provided hooks and filters. The plugin architecture is designed for extensibility.

Does it support variable products?

Yes, the plugin fully supports all WooCommerce product types including variable products, grouped products, and external products.

Will my existing meta tags be affected?

The plugin is designed to work alongside existing meta tags. You can configure it to override other plugins’ tags or let them work together.

Is there analytics support?

Yes, the plugin includes Google Analytics 4 integration and custom event triggers for comprehensive social sharing analytics.

Can I use this with page builders?

Yes, the plugin works with all major page builders including Elementor, Divi, Beaver Builder, Gutenberg, and others.

How do I test if it’s working?

Use these free testing tools:
* Facebook Sharing Debugger
* Twitter Card Validator
* Google Rich Results Test
* LinkedIn Post Inspector

Can I position share buttons anywhere?

Yes! The plugin offers 4 built-in positions plus a [wog_social_share] shortcode for custom placement anywhere on your site.

Does it work on mobile devices?

Absolutely! All share buttons are optimized for mobile devices with touch-friendly interfaces and native sharing APIs where available.
sections.changelog:
2.0.1 – 2025-01-10

Micro Update – WordPress.org Compliance

  • Renamed plugin from “Woo Open Graph” to “Open Graph for WooCommerce” for trademark compliance
  • Updated text domain to match new plugin slug
  • Updated all internal references and documentation
  • No functionality changes – all features remain the same

2.0.0 – 2024-12-15

Major Release – Complete Rewrite

New Features:
* Complete plugin architecture rewrite with modern OOP design
* Added three beautiful share button styles: Modern, Classic, and Minimal
* Introduced WhatsApp and Email sharing options
* Added comprehensive Schema.org structured data support
* Advanced image handling with multiple size options and smart fallbacks
* Copy-to-clipboard functionality with modern clipboard API
* Professional settings import/export functionality
* Real-time form validation in admin interface

Performance Improvements:
* 70% reduction in asset size (from ~105KB to ~28KB)
* Reduced database queries by 60%
* Implemented conditional asset loading
* Optimized image processing and caching
* Added lazy loading for non-critical resources
* Minimized and optimized CSS and JavaScript files

Security Enhancements:
* Added comprehensive input sanitization and validation
* Implemented nonce verification for all forms
* Added capability checks for admin access
* Enhanced XSS and CSRF protection
* Improved data escape functions throughout

User Experience:
* Redesigned admin interface with modern, responsive design
* Improved mobile responsiveness across all interfaces
* Added intuitive navigation and visual hierarchy
* Implemented contextual help and validation messages
* Enhanced accessibility with ARIA labels and keyboard navigation

Developer Features:
* Added 20+ new action and filter hooks
* Implemented comprehensive JavaScript API
* Added extensive customization options
* Improved code documentation and structure
* Added debug mode with detailed logging

Accessibility Improvements:
* Added ARIA labels and roles throughout
* Implemented keyboard navigation support
* Added screen reader announcements
* Ensured WCAG 2.1 compliance
* Added high contrast mode support

Bug Fixes:
* Fixed meta tag conflicts with other SEO plugins
* Resolved image URL encoding issues
* Fixed variable product support issues
* Corrected RTL language display problems
* Fixed caching conflicts with major caching plugins

1.0.1 – Previous Version

  • Added LinkedIn and Pinterest support
  • Basic social media share buttons
  • Simple Open Graph meta tags

1.0.0 – Initial Release

  • Basic Facebook and Twitter Open Graph support
  • Simple admin interface
  • Basic product meta tag generation
